description: This file implements functions for fixing MD5 checksums in WRGG headers within MTD flash devices, including reading, verifying, updating headers, and handling raw device I/O.

methods.name: uint32_t le32_to_cpu(uint8_t * buf)
methods.description: Converts a 4-byte little-endian buffer to a 32-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: int wrgg_fix_md5(struct wrgg03_header * shdr,int fd,size_t data_offset,size_t data_size)
methods.description: Calculates and updates the MD5 checksum in a WRGG header if needed.

methods.name: int mtd_fixwrgg(const char * mtd,size_t offset,size_t data_size)
methods.description: Fixes the WRGG header in a specified MTD device at a given offset.

ctags.name: wrgg_fix_md5
ctags.pattern: /^wrgg_fix_md5(struct wrgg03_header *shdr, int fd, size_t data_offset, size_t data_size)$/
